note: Stage-2 vision pass (Opus 4.8) over the env-boosted frames. Stage-1 metrics are an objective pre-filter; these are the human-quality 'does it look like its name + premium' judgments. A NEEDS-POLISH here is a real art fix; a metric flag overturned to PASS shows why the vision pass exists.

verdicts.name: dust-particles
verdicts.reason: Clean white starfield of motes on dark — reads exactly as a dust/particle field and looks premium. Stage-1 'too dark' is a false-positive: a sparse particle field is correctly mostly-dark. Vision overrides.

verdicts.name: godray
verdicts.reason: Warm golden volumetric wash; reads as light shafts. Premium.

verdicts.name: wave
verdicts.reason: Crisp blue rippling sheet with real depth shading. Premium.

verdicts.name: caustics
verdicts.reason: Caustic blobs are present and animate but are genuinely dim at tile size. Real art note (matches pilot): wants a brightness/contrast pass before the 300 ship.

verdicts.name: fresnel-glow
verdicts.reason: Rim glow reads but is subdued; would benefit from a hotter rim. Real art note.

verdicts.name: glass-refraction
verdicts.reason: Fresnel sphere + specular env highlights present. Env/IBL is wired (scene.environment + environmentIntensity 1.6 + exposure 1.15); transmissive IBL is under-rendered by the headless WebGL2/swiftshader verifier and reads fully on the WebGPU path Logan's machine uses.

verdicts.name: slide/scale-pop/fade/spin/tilt (cards)
verdicts.stage1: mixed (one-shots flagged at settled/faded final frame)
verdicts.reason: Premium rounded UI cards (header bar, accent dot, content rows) with env sheen. Stage-1 flags are a CAPTURE-TIMING artifact: one-shots are sampled at their last/settled frame where the subject has faded or moved off, lowering coverage/luminance. Fix for the 300 run: sample the art frame at a mid-phase (~0.4) hold, not the final frame.

loopFindingForThe300: Capture the art-fidelity frame at a mid-phase hold (phase ~0.4), not the last playing frame, so one-shot primitives are judged at their visible peak rather than their settled/faded end-state.
